newsitem.title: UK: Alpha Airports sells U.S. airport kitchens.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Airports sells U.S. airport kitchens.

text.p: Alpha Airports Group Plc said on Monday it was selling its loss-making U.S. flight catering kitchens at JFK, Newark, Miami and Orlando airports -- to Chicago-based Flying Food Group for 6.8 million stg cash.
"The continuing difficult market conditions in the U.S. have meant those operations remain loss making," said Alpha's chief executive Paul Harrison.
Alpha said it would retain net working capital of about 3.2 million stg.
Alpha's U.S. operations, excluding Sanford, have tangible assets of around 6.0 million stg and reported a loss before tax in the year to January 31 of 3.3 million stg on sales of 20.8 million stg.
Goodwill attributable to the operations totalled 11.5 million stg, the company stated.
